idea.idea: Cutting automation costs by 90% with dedicated decision models
idea.angle: Stop routing simple dispatch and customer triage tasks through expensive general LLMs when fast decision APIs do the exact routing for pennies.
idea.audience_problem: Small business automation systems become unexpectedly expensive when full reasoning models are used for basic if-then categorization.

slides.title: Stop using expensive AI models for simple business decisions
slides.subtitle: Use focused decision APIs to route tasks 10x faster for pennies.

slides.title: Standard AI vs. Decision APIs
slides.subtitle: Why general reasoning models are often overkill for daily tasks.

slides.title: The Scaling Trap
slides.myth: Using one powerful AI model for every single business task is cost-effective.
slides.fact: At scale, the cost and latency of general models add up quickly; specialized decision APIs are built for high-volume, simple routing tasks.

slides.title: How to set it up
slides.subtitle: Follow these steps to replace expensive logic flows.
items: Define your question and allowed answers
Provide context as text or JSON inputs
Choose probability, choice, or score types
Route the action based on the result

slides.title: Before you automate
slides.subtitle: Check these criteria for your decision tasks.
items: Is the decision binary or limited?
Do you have predefined allowed answers?
Are you processing high-volume routine data?
Can you map it to a score?

slides.title: Efficiency matters
slides.quote: Applications and agents make many small decisions throughout a workflow: how to classify an input, where to route a request, or which action to take next.

slides.title: Key Takeaways
slides.body: Keep your automation lean by using the right tool for the job.
items: Decisions API is for bounded logic
Supports text, image, and JSON inputs

piece.caption: Stop paying for intelligence you don't need. If your business automation involves simple routing—like sorting customer emails, classifying transaction types, or checking if a product image shows damage—you don't need a heavy, general-purpose LLM. Dedicated decision APIs are significantly faster and cheaper. At $0.10 per million input tokens with no output fees, it’s a practical way to scale your operations without your cloud bill spiraling out of control. Start by picking one recurring, repetitive decision your team makes every day and move it to a dedicated endpoint. What is one repetitive manual categorization task your team handles that could be automated?

claims.claim: Decisions API focuses on questions with bounded answers and is up to 10x faster than GPT-6 Luna.
The Decisions API supports three answer types: probability, choice, and score.
Decisions API costs $0.10 per million input tokens with no output-token charges.
Developers can pass native JSON inputs and include images in question instructions.
